description: Analogue hi-hat voice with separate closed and open triggers, a bank of metallic oscillators and a noise source, each with its own output

params.text: Sets how long a closed hi-hat rings on after a trigger
Sets how long an open hi-hat rings on after a trigger
Sets the cutoff of the filter on the hi-hat
Sets the pulse width of the metallic oscillators
Attenuates the voltage at the MOD input before it changes the pulse width
Sets the pitch of the metallic oscillators
Sets the output level of the closed hi-hat
Sets the output level of the open hi-hat
Sets how much louder a hit is when a gate is present at the ACCENT input as the hat is triggered
Attenuates the voltage at the FM input before it changes the oscillator pitch
Sets the balance between the metallic oscillators and the noise, marked met at one end and noisy at the other

inputs.text: A rising edge here fires a closed hi-hat
A rising edge here fires an open hi-hat
A gate here at the moment of a trigger makes that hit louder, by the amount set by the ACCENT knob
Voltage control of the pulse width of the metallic oscillators, scaled by the MOD knob
Voltage control of the metallic oscillator pitch, scaled by the FM knob

outputs.text: The noise source on its own
The bank of metallic oscillators on its own
The finished hi-hat, as a single audio signal

notes: no sound comes out until a trigger arrives at one of the two TRIG jacks; the knobs shape a hit and none of them sounds on its own
one ACCENT jack serves both TRIG jacks, so a gate there makes the next closed hit and the next open hit louder alike
